productionBaseline.terminalResourcePolicyCanaryModule: absent in both PH-001 baseline and RED

contractStrengthening.leaseAuthority: Server and frontend both require issuer-local provenance. Structural clones and leases from identically configured rogue issuers are rejected without mutating target, queue, scheduler, ledger or cleanup state. Authority-only immutable metadata exposes issuanceSequence and targetEpoch without placing them on the lease payload.
contractStrengthening.defaultUnavailable: The real registered stable profile set is empty and default RuntimeConfigStore enforcement remains candidate-unavailable. Test contracts enter only through the explicit boot authority constructor seam.
contractStrengthening.invalidContracts: Every draft/evolving, wrong policy/profile/schema/capability, NaN, Infinity, negative or fractional boot contract is selected by its own contractId and must fail before lease issuance.
contractStrengthening.rejectionParity: Forged, rogue and stale paths compare authoritative configs, target generation/decision/ledger, cleanup registries, queues, connection identity, scheduler state and other-target state before and after rejection.
contractStrengthening.ledgerAccounting: Selection, capacity+K admissions, rejection, transition and rollback have exact event deltas, exact latest-N suffix and exact dropped count. A missing second headless adapter contributes exactly one payload-free adapter-transition-rejected event with the exact target, decisions, reason and not-applied rollback result.
contractStrengthening.atomicFailure: A fresh first-adapter lease is applied before a real missing-session second-adapter failure. Operational configs, queues, producer, connection and authority state restore exactly; generation remains monotonic and both the successful-first-adapter rollback and failing-second-adapter rejection remain auditable.
contractStrengthening.killSwitch: Rollback revokes the entire target epoch. The used lease and an unused lease issued before rollback are both state-preserving lease-revoked results for activation and admission. Only a post-rollback lease with a newer targetEpoch and issuanceSequence can create a newer candidate generation.
contractStrengthening.callbackBoundary: Rollback is already closed at the post-rollback legacy frame send boundary, proving finalization occurs at the last candidate callback.
contractStrengthening.frontendCapability: Capability undefined returns a lease-free legacy decision and the scheduler rejection path preserves queue, stale, snapshot and scheduling state.
